full_judgment: Respondent No.1 as the plaintiff instituted Mortgage Suit No.68 of 1978' in the Third Court of Subordinate Judge, Chittagong for redemption of 1.25 acres of lands described in schedules 1 and 2 to the plaint. His case, in short, is that the disputed property described in the schedule to the plaint belonged to late Prasanna Kumar Dutta father of the plaintiff and proforma defendants by purchase and exchange. The father of the plaintiff mortgaged the disputed property to defendant Nos.1, 2, and 3 and father of defendant Nos.4-6 for Tk.6000 (six thousand) by a mortgage deed dated 25-11-1962 registered on 13-12-1962 and delivered the possession of the mortgaged land to the mortgagee that with a view to avoiding legal complications. The deed was executed as a deed of sale but from the long period of 10 years mentioned in the deed as well as from the subsequent conducts of the parties, it would clearly appear that the intention of the parties was to make it a mortgage by conditional sale. The mortgage was to be redeemed within 10 years. The mortgagees enjoyed the mortgaged properties for over 15 years for the principal amount and maximum interest available to the mortgagees thereon. Anukul Dutta and Natun Dutta were co-sharers in the khatian of the mortgaged land. Kuntala Dutta, daughter of Anukul Dutta, instituted Partition Suit No.39 of 1964 in the Third Court of Subordinate Judge, Chittagong for partition of the suit land along with other ejmali land. The said partition suit was disposed of on 10.8.1968 on the basis of a solenama, which was made part of the decree. In the sole decree, it was provided that the suit land being in mortgage by conditional sale would be partitioned after redemption and after redemption, the heirs of Prasanna Kumar (the plaintiff and defendant Nos.7 to 13 of the said partition suit) would get 1/3rd share in the present suit land. The plaintiff filed Miscellaneous Case No.178· of 1972-73 in the Court of the then Sub-Divisional Officer, Chittagong for redemption of the suit land. The Sub-Divisional Officer by his order dated 21-2-1974 allowed the redemption and directed the defendants (appellants herein) under section 95 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act to restore possession to the plaintiff by 10-3- 1974. Meanwhile, the High Court Division declared the relevant law as illegal and void and, as such, the plaintiff has subsequently instituted the present suit for the reliefs as stated above in the plaint. The defendants in Pre-emption Case No.106 of 1973 in the Court of Munsif, First Court, Chittagong, admitted that the suit land is mortgaged property.
